payload.rewritten_goal:
Review a malpractice matter centered on delayed fracture recognition using the provided operative note evidence summary, nursing note evidence summary, and X-ray evidence. Before replying with the final legal summary, the team must:
1. inspect the procedure, nursing, and imaging materials,
2. verify the fracture-related chart artifact,
3. compute the exposure estimate,
4. draft the internal memo and notice path,
5. execute a hold-notice step.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- operative note: Operative-note document excerpt from the malpractice file. Extracted content: Operative Note Operative-note document excerpt from the malpractice file. Details Document Title Operative Note entity_id X-ray appears in header or exhibit label Procedure Date 2023-09-14 Procedure Name Closed reduction and splinting of left distal radius fracture Preoperative Diagnosis Left wrist injury with pain and deformity Postoperative Diagnosis Displaced left distal radius fracture Anesthesia Moderate sedation with local hematoma block Performing Provider Jordan Patel, MD Imaging Reference Intra-procedure review of X-ray confirmed distal radius fracture alignment Estimated Blood Loss Minimal Complications None Disposition Transferred to recovery in stable condition with neurovascular status intact Additional Information a realistic 2-page hospital operative-note document excerpt using reportlab Use a professional medical-record layout with a facility header, patient/chart metadata block, date/time lines, and an exhibit marker that includes the entity ID 'X-ray' in the header or upper margin Title the document 'Operative Note' standard sections such as Preoperative Diagnosis, Postoperative Diagnosis, Procedure Performed, Indications, Consent, Anesthesia, Procedure Details, Findings, Imaging Review, Estimated Blood Loss, Complications, and Disposition provider signature lines and timestamps near the end This report is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
- nursing note: Nursing-note document excerpt documenting post-procedure escalation. Extracted content: Nursing Note Nursing-note document excerpt documenting post-procedure escalation. Details Document Title Nursing Note entity_id X-ray appears in header or cross-reference field Note Date 2023-09-14 Note Time 19:40 Author Role Registered Nurse Post Procedure Status Patient reports persistent severe left wrist pain after procedure Pain Score 8/10 Neurovascular Assessment Fingers cool with capillary refill 3 seconds Swelling Observation Increased swelling noted at left wrist/forearm Escalation Action Orthopedic provider notified of uncontrolled pain and swelling Imaging Followup Requested review of X-ray due to concern for missed or persistent fracture issue Disposition Plan Continued monitoring with repeat assessment after provider callback Additional Information a realistic 2-page nursing-note document excerpt using reportlab Use a hospital clinical-document format with patient identifiers, unit/location, note date/time, and a header or reference line containing the entity ID 'X-ray' Title the document 'Nursing Note' common nursing fields and sections such as Post-Procedure Assessment, Pain Assessment, Neurovascular Check, Provider Notification, Escalation, and Follow-up Plan one or more late-shift escalation entries documenting worsening symptoms and communication with a provider This report is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
